purpose: Versioned, sourced capture of every rate used by this engine on this date. Re-run scenarios against this file to reproduce September 2026 results even after live vendor pricing changes.

entries.fact: Pro $20/mo + $20 usage credit; commercial use requires Pro, not Hobby
Active CPU excludes I/O wait (DB queries, AI model calls); Provisioned Memory bills for the full in-flight duration including I/O wait
Free tier to 50,000 MAU; Pro $25/mo includes 100,000 MAU; overage $0.00325/MAU beyond that
Free 500,000 commands/mo; PAYG $0.20/100K commands with no free-allowance carry-over on upgrade; Fixed plans from $10/mo (250MB)

Free 3,000/mo; Pro $20/50K and $35/100K; Scale $90/100K down to $1,150/2.5M with overage tiering from $0.90 to $0.46 per 1,000; verified crossover where Scale beats Pro on pure price is ~455,000-460,000 emails/month, not the commonly-assumed ~200,000

Claude Sonnet 5: $2/$10 per M input/output confirmed as the standing rate (a previously-announced $3/$15 September increase did not take effect); cache writes 1.25x (5-min) / 2x (1-hr); cache reads 0.1x
GPT-5.6 Sol: $4/$20 per M, promotional through 2026-11-21 (standard rate $5/$30); long-context tier above 272K tokens roughly doubles input/cache and multiplies output 1.5x on the full request

Gemini 3.1 Pro: $2/$12 to 200K tokens, $4/$18 beyond; Gemini 3.8 Flash: $0.75/$3.75 introductory through 2026-12-31, rising to $1.50/$7.50 on 2027-01-01; 5,000 free Search-grounding requests/month shared across the Gemini 3.x family, then $14/1,000

known_unknowns: GPT-5.6 Sol's exact long-context multiplier is derived from the documented ratio pattern at the non-promotional $5/$30 rate, applied to the current promotional base -- treat as a reasoned estimate, not a vendor-confirmed figure, until OpenAI publishes the promotional long-context rate explicitly.
Supabase compute-tier, storage, and egress costs beyond the Micro instance are not modeled -- infrastructure.cost only covers the Auth/MAU billing meter, Upstash, and Resend.
